new_value: {"notes":"Implemented (uncommitted): cmd_query + tier_at in git-vouch, tests/test_query.py. Contract for faq3.4: stdout JSON {did, at, handle, tier, automation, emails, added, retired, revoked, valid}; exit 0 known, exit 1 + same JSON with handle null if unknown, exit 1 + empty stdout if registry check fails (fail closed, as export), exit 2 bad --at. Tier at TIME uses export's model (current tier or one in result.ended ending after TIME). Bridge rule: valid and emails and not automation. No [DIR] arg: queries the synced copy (or cwd before setup)."}
